file_roles.evidence: Diff moves `if security_enabled: hive_principal = ...` from the end of the file to before line ~403 where format() reads {hive_principal}; the old order caused KeyError 'hive_principal'.

rationale: The traceback shows KeyError: 'hive_principal' at params_linux.py line 403. The fix only reorders the definition of hive_principal in the same file so it is defined before use. The ordering error was in this file.
